addSheet.label: Insert Sheet
addSheet.description: Insert sheet before the current sheet.

deleteSheet.label: Delete Sheet
deleteSheet.description: Delete the sheet and all the data.

hideSheet.label: Hide Sheet
hideSheet.description: Hide the sheet from appearing in the tabs. This keeps the data but de-clutters the tabs.

workbookViewToggleShowFormulaBar.label: View Formula bar
workbookViewToggleShowFormulaBar.description: Show or hide the formula bar.

workbookViewToggleShowTabs.label: View Sheet Tabs
workbookViewToggleShowTabs.description: Show or hide the sheet tabs.

workbookViewToggleShowStatusBar.label: View Status Bar
workbookViewToggleShowStatusBar.description: Show or hide the status bar.

workbookViewToggleShowHorizontalScrollBa.label: View Horizontal Scrollbar
workbookViewToggleShowHorizontalScrollBa.description: Show or hide the horizontal scrollbar.

workbookViewToggleShowVerticalScrollBar.label: View Vertical Scrollbar
workbookViewToggleShowVerticalScrollBar.description: Show or hide the vertical scrollbar.

workbookViewToggleExpandFormulaBar.label: Toggle Expand Formula bar
workbookViewToggleExpandFormulaBar.description: Expand or collapse the formula bar.

locale.label: Regional Format
locale.description: The regional format used for numbers and dates. This is saved with the workbook.

newCellStyle.label: New Cell Style…
newCellStyle.description: Create a new named style can can be quickly used later.

deleteCellStyle.label: Delete Cell Style
deleteCellStyle.description: Remove a named style that is no longer needed.

modifyCellStyle.label: Modify Cell Style
modifyCellStyle.description: Update a style with the currently style.

findNext.label: Find Next
findNext.description: Find the next match of the last search, without opening the Find window.

findPrevious.label: Find Previous
findPrevious.description: Find the previous match of the last search, without opening the Find window.

addNamedReference.label: Define Named Reference
addNamedReference.description: Add a new named reference. Names can be used as a substitute for cell references.

editNamedReference.label: Edit Named Reference…
editNamedReference.description: Edit the named reference. Names can be used as a substitute for cell references.

insertFunction.label: Insert Function
insertFunction.description: Insert a function into the current cell.

selectTheme.label: Theme
selectTheme.description: Select a theme that coveys a style suitable for your data.

calculateAll.label: Calculate Now
calculateAll.description: Recalculate the formulas whose values are out of date, on every sheet.

calculateFull.label: Calculate Full
calculateFull.description: Recalculate every formula in the workbook, including those already up to date. Use this to replace the values a file was opened with.

calcModeAutomatic.label: Automatic
calcModeAutomatic.description: Recalculate formulas whenever their inputs change.

calcModeAutomaticExceptTables.label: Automatic Except for Data Tables
calcModeAutomaticExceptTables.description: Recalculate formulas whenever their inputs change, except what-if data tables. Without data tables this is the same as Automatic.

calcModeManual.label: Manual
calcModeManual.description: Recalculate only when you ask (F9). Edits leave dependent formulas out of date until then.

calcIterativeToggle.label: Enable Iterative Calculation
calcIterativeToggle.description: Resolve circular references by recalculating them repeatedly until they settle or the maximum iterations is reached. Off, a circular reference evaluates to 0.

selectDirectPrecedents.label: Select Direct Precedents
selectDirectPrecedents.description: Select the cells directly referenced by the formulas in the selection.

selectPrecedents.label: Select All Precedents
selectPrecedents.description: Select all cells that contribute to the formulas in the selection, following the entire calculation chain.

selectDirectDependents.label: Select Direct Dependents
selectDirectDependents.description: Select the cells with formulas that directly reference the selection.

selectDependents.label: Select All Dependents
selectDependents.description: Select all cells that are eventually affected by the selection, following the entire calculation chain.

activeNameBox.label: Activate Name Box
activeNameBox.description: Move the focus to the name box.

activeNameManager.label: Name Manager
activeNameManager.description:
Create, edit, delete, and find all the names used in the workbook.

Names can be used as a substitute for cell references.

createNamedReferenceFromSelection.label: Create from Selection
createNamedReferenceFromSelection.description: Automatically generate names from the selected cells.

spellCheck.label: Spell Check
spellCheck.description: Check the workbook for spelling mistakes.
